measures.questionText: Shall the Act be approved which provides a homestead exemption from City of Statham ad valorem taxes for municipal purposes in the amount of $20,000.00 of the assessed value of the homestead for residents of that city who are 62 years of age or older and an additional exemption in the amount of $10,000.00 of the assessed value of the homestead for residents of that city who are 67 years of age or older?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: The official ballot proposes exempting $20,000 of assessed homestead value from Statham city property taxes for qualifying residents age 62 or older, plus another $10,000 at age 67 or older. The age tests apply on January 1 of the application year; city bond taxes are excluded from this exemption. It adds to other city-tax homestead exemptions and does not apply to state, county or school property taxes; assessed value above the exemption remains taxable. The resident or an agent must apply to the city or its designee; the exemption then renews while the home remains the resident’s homestead, and recipients must report loss of eligibility. The Act sets January 1, 2027 as the effective date if voters approve. The Act’s operative exemption clauses contain malformed dollar figures: $20,00.00 and $10,00.00.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the proposed senior city-tax homestead exemption.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject the proposed senior city-tax homestead exemption.
